rationale: The file contains recognizable HLF transaction entrypoints (Init, Invoke, and helper functions). All transaction logic reads deterministic state via stub.GetState(), unmarshals JSON, applies deterministic state machine transitions (status checks and field updates), and writes via stub.PutState() or stub.DelState(). The Gasoline struct contains a map field (Message), but it is only populated via deterministic key-value assignments (gasoline.Message[gasoline.Status] = _msg) where the key is the current status string, not iterated over. No time-dependent operations, goroutines, non-revalidated queries, or global mutable state influence ledger writes or responses.
